# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM provider interface for code generation and analysis |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates test and implementation code via LLM prompts |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Executes RED→GREEN→REFACTOR for Python using WorkerAgent + PodmanOrchestrator |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | Executes TDD phases for Go language |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Orchestrates one TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning loop |
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Iterates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR until planner signals completion |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines next test increment based on current state |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Manages container heartbeat, file pulses, and security checks |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Rootless Podman container lifecycle and test execution |
| ContainerRunner | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Protocol for container runners (send_pulse, start, stop) |
| LanguagePod | src/agents/language_pod.py | Protocol for language-specific TDD pods |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Playbook CRUD, delta updates, semantic deduplication, persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes generator output and environment feedback to extract insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesises insights into playbook bullets and applies updates |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword) for relevant playbook bullets |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Validates generated code against forbidden imports and builtins |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses .feature files into structured FeatureSpec |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Full incremental TDD agent with ensemble learning and session bullets |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records failures and interventions for self-healing |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on phase |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Drives TDD across multiple language pods and compares efficiency |
| PodFactory | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Creates LanguagePod instances for a given language identifier |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Runner->>+Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
    Planner-->>-Runner: TestIncrement

    loop over cycles (max_iterations)
        Runner->>+Cycle: run(spec)
        
        Cycle->>+Pod: run_red(spec)
        Pod->>+Worker: generate_test(spec, existing_code)
        Worker->>+Playbook: get_bullets(test_assertion_rules)
        Playbook-->>-Worker: bullet list
        Worker-->>-Pod: test_code
        Pod->>+Orch: pulse(files)
        Orch-->>-Pod: PhaseResult (red)
        Pod-->>-Cycle: red_result

        alt RED aborted (security failure)
            Note right of Cycle: abort cycle
        else GREEN phase
            loop max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>+Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                Pod->>+Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
                Worker->>+Playbook: get_bullets(strategies_and_hard_rules)
                Playbook-->>-Worker: bullet list
                Worker-->>-Pod: impl_code
                Pod->>+Orch: pulse(files)
                Orch-->>-Pod: PhaseResult (green)
                Pod-->>-Cycle: green_result
                alt GREEN passed or abort
                    break
                else
                    Note right of Cycle: retry with error feedback
                end
            end
        end

        Cycle->>+Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        Pod->>+Orch: pulse(files)
        Orch-->>-Pod: PhaseResult (refactor)
        Pod-->>-Cycle: refactor_result

        Cycle->>+Logger: log_tdd_cycle(cycle_data)
        Logger-->>-Cycle: logged

        opt GREEN passed and reflector/curator configured
            Cycle->>+Reflector: reflect(task, generator_output, env_feedback)
            Reflector-->>-Cycle: ReflectorOutput
            Cycle->>+Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            Curator-->>-Cycle: CuratorOutput
            Cycle->>+Playbook: apply_updates(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            Playbook-->>-Cycle: added_bullet_ids
        end

        Cycle-->>-Runner: CycleResult
        Runner->>+Planner: record_test_written(test_file, test_name, test_code, cycle_number)
        Planner-->>-Runner: recorded

        alt planner signals COMPLETE
            Note right of Runner: exit loop
        end
    end

    Runner-->>Runner: return IterativeResult
```
